parameters.prompt: Create an actual animated GIF using the attached approved illustration as the exact visual and composition reference. This is a Thai suburban municipal office in warm, detailed watercolor and gouache on ivory paper. Keep the original architecture, cream walls, tiled roof, parked pickup and motorbikes, people, perspective, sunlight, paper texture and palette. The camera remains locked. Animate a gentle, clearly visible, natural breeze in the outer tree leaves and in the Thai flag's cloth only. Branches sway organically and the cloth ripples with coherent motion; the pole, office and people stay still. Preserve crisp architectural edges, foliage detail and recognizable people at the requested 640x800 output size. Make the complete sequence a smooth repeating loop with a matching start/end pose. No camera pan or zoom, no scene transition, no blanket distortion across the picture. Return one animated GIF, not a static image and not a visible contact sheet or storyboard grid.

raw_output_policy: Save provider GIF bytes without resizing, warping, frame interpolation, or local animation generation.
